description:
Create a 'Members Only' product page for VIP customers.

1. Create a new taxonomy term named 'VIP' in the 'Product categories' vocabulary.
2. Assign this 'VIP' term to the following products: 'Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless Headphones' and 'Logitech MX Master 3S Wireless Mouse'.
3. Create a new Page View with the following requirements:
   - Page Title: 'VIP Exclusives'
   - Path: /vip-products
   - Display format: Grid
   - Filter: Show only products tagged with the 'VIP' category.
   - Access restrictions: The page must be visible ONLY to logged-in users (Role: Authenticated user).

The final page at http://localhost/vip-products should show the two products when logged in, and be inaccessible (403 Access Denied) to anonymous visitors.
